releaseMeaning: Green release checks cover implemented behavior only. Listed wire vectors remain TODO and cannot be represented as conformance successes.

requirements.requirement: Implement production RTME frame parser and reject authenticated payload byte mutations.
Bind canonical payload digest to verified node signature; reject digest-and-payload rewrites.
Persist/recheck transport nonce replay state on the receiving RTME transport.
Verify signed transport envelope expiry against bounded clock skew.
Independently verify ActionToken under K_auth; node signature alone is not authority.
Verify authenticated receiver_node_id matches actual receiving node.
Enforce frame payload byte limit before semantic deserialization.
Reject duplicate JSON keys before semantic deserialization under canonical wire profile.
Reject noncanonical or unsupported numeric representations before semantic deserialization.
Pin and validate DNS addresses at connection time, including rebinding scenarios; mocks alone do not prove this.
Persist RECOVERY_REQUIRED for ambiguous remote effect results; never blindly retry.
On actual remote execution path recheck CURRENT authenticated consent, not user-supplied consent_state.
On actual remote execution path require signed ActionToken; node/mTLS identity alone is not execution authority.
